about.title: Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church
about.p: Our church is established based on the teachings and doctrines of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church, a member of the Oriental Orthodox churches. We strive to fulfil the spiritual needs of our members through worship, the seven sacraments, and the teaching of Holy Scripture. Come and join us in this spiritual journey.

cta.title: Join Our Community
cta.p: Whether you are new to Christchurch or looking for a spiritual home, you are welcome here. Come worship with us.
